reasons.persona_fit: Accurately targets small-business owner-operators with Bareni's calm, practical voice, though inserting delivery account policies into a problem-awareness post feels slightly abrupt.
reasons.clarity: The argument unfolds cleanly and logically, explaining why extraction alone leaves manual work and providing clear, plain-language qualifications.
reasons.actionability: Gives a concrete, self-contained exercise for the reader to evaluate recurring downstream rules and quantify weekly time before seeking automation.
reasons.factual_grounding: Every operational boundary, policy statement, and system capability (duplicate checks, audit logs, human approval before money moves) is fully grounded in C02–C04.
